name: Heart-friendly Chole
ingredients: Chole masala, amchur and 1 tsp oil
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and cook until completely soft.
Prepare onion-tomato masala with minimal oil.
Mash a few chickpeas; simmer and finish with amchur.
note: Serve with one small roti rather than bhature for a more balanced meal.
